newsitem.title: USA: Pier 1 Imports January same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Pier 1 Imports January same-store sales up.

text.p: Pier 1 Imports Inc said Thursday that sales for the four-week period ended February 1, 1997, totaled $65,347,000, an increase of 31.1 percent from $49,851,000.
Comparable store sales increased 19.6 percent for the period. Year-to-date sales of $885,694,000 were up 18.9 percent from last year's $745,032,000 and same store sales grew 12.6 percent.
Pier 1 Imports is a specialty retailer of imported decorative home furnishings, gifts and related items with 725 stores in 47 states, Puerto Rico, Canada, the United Kingdom, Japan and Mexico.
